cases.answer: AICR snapshot and diff report observed differences between GPU nodes without selecting a recipe or deploying a bundle. To decide whether a difference is a fault, compare each node with the provider-curated source variant intended for its service, accelerator, operating system, workload intent, platform, and relevant hardware.
cases.claimBoundary: These sanitized snapshots prove that two observations differ. They do not select an intended variant or prove that either node is misconfigured.
cases.question: What do I have?
requiredInputs: access to the GPU nodes being measured
